conditions.acceleration: Full throttle from rest at 100 m; fixed authored mass; unchanged automatic shifts and assistance.
conditions.braking: Release throttle and request full brake after the acceleration run; stop below 0.1 m/s or after 30 s.
conditions.braking100: Fresh vehicle rolling at 100 km/h; initial controls released, then full brake through existing actuator rates.
conditions.restart: Full throttle for 8 s after stopping.
conditions.cornering: Fresh vehicle at 25 m/s; 12 s, throttle 0.3, steering 0.25*sin(time), front steering rule 0.8.
conditions.terminalRangeKph: Observed final ten seconds of a fixed 240 s run; not a guaranteed equilibrium or real-car top speed.
